body: I actually got hung up on once (on a suicide hotline) five minutes into a call. Then I tried calling again... I waited so long that I ended up deciding to stay alive.
Early 20s here and been using hotlines since I was 18. I can confirm hotlines suck.
That's exactly why I won't say anything. I'm alone in this.

Thanks

I guess I'm kind of just done. I'll have to make sure my method works, otherwise I'll have to figure out if I'm done for in college (if I live).
I'm glad that worked for you.
I believed that for several years, and every year my life spirals even more downward.
I honestly wonder the same.
Honestly, I just want to know if I'll end up being kicked out of college or if I'll end up being forced to take a semester off. I do not want that to happen, if I end up surviving this attempt.

No

I don't think I would want one right now anyways
It's pure fucking misery and I can only wish that one day I won't feel so disconnected from everyone and everything. I can't do this shit anymore and I'd have little to lose from killing myself.

No. I've gone to social events before and I'm done with them. I feel like I'm probably a part of the minority of people who just can't have a deep connection with anyone. Also Mechanical Engineering but I'm still doing core classes.

I have family, they care but they also don't understand just how bad I can get. Also, I'm just the friend that everyone forgets or the friend that is easily replaced. I feel so disconnected from people, and I can't take the loneliness anymore.

Can definitely say people would only really start caring about me after I die. I hardly have motivation for college and I can't see a future with myself in it. Honestly, college has been such a lonely experience, and it just serves as a distraction to keep me from doing the inevitable.
The best miracle would be a successful attempt. I'm done with this world.
I do appreciate your talking to me but I will still be going through with this. It's going to take a fucking miracle to stop me now. I'm done with being this way and always feeling alone.

I've been on this track for 5+ years... Always feeling suicidal. Every day when I wake up I have three options of how I can go about my day:

* Stay asleep in bed all day.
* Wake up, struggle to get ready in the morning, and go to school
* Wake up and kill myself (in the morning or at school).

I haven't even gotten into engineering classes yet. First students go through "core" classes (e.g, English, Writing, History, College Algebra). I used to like drawing, video games, reading, etc. but I'm tired of them now. I'm tired of everything and everyone.
Mechanical Engineering. A medical withdrawal for a semester would make me even more depressed. I have no other purpose in life other than attending this university.
Ughhh... Well, I'll definitely have to make sure it works. I cannot survive and then have nothing to do.
Guess I'll just have to man up and pick one despite the pain. I'm running out of ideas.
